info.name: HIP Disease Chatbot Sessions
info.description:
Final reply shape. Requires CHATBOT_DISEASE_ENABLED=true.

Build every screen from options[]. messages[] is display only. disease_cards, summary, and payment are message types. Do not copy a message type into input.type. Read input.type from the input object. input.mode is the same string and is deprecated.

A value option is sent as {"input":{"type":"<step input.type>","value":"<option id>"}}.
An action (kind "action") is sent as {"input":{"type":"option","value":"<id>"}} on any step, including doctor, date, slot, and payment.

kind "value" is an answer: Yes, No, Confirm booking, Use coins, Don't use coins, Pay now, and a symptom, person, speciality, doctor, date, or slot.
kind "action" is navigation: Restart, Start over, Choose another time, Change time, Continue anyway, Choose symptoms again, Choose another speciality, Choose another doctor, Choose another date, Use fewer.

## ASK_SYMPTOMS
Chips are options[] with style and selected_style. input.type is multi_option. input.max is the selection limit (chatbot.max_symptoms, default 15). input.submit is the Continue button. input.searchable filters the list on the device. Send option ids, not labels: {"input":{"type":"multi_option","value":["wheezing","cough"]}}.

## CHOOSE_DOCTOR, CHOOSE_DATE, CHOOSE_SLOT
One text line (Pick a doctor. / Pick a date. / Pick a time.). No date_picker, doctor_list, or slot_list message.
- Doctor option: id is the uuid, label is the name, plus speciality, fee, photo, experience, next_available. Send {"input":{"type":"doctor","value":"<uuid>"}}.
- Date option: only dates with free slots. id is YYYY-MM-DD, label is like Sat, 17 Oct, plus slots_count and available true. Send {"input":{"type":"date","value":"2026-10-17"}}.
- Slot option: id and label are the time, plus group Morning (before 12:00), Afternoon (12:00–16:59), or Evening (from 17:00). Build the grouped layout from group. Action buttons have no group. Send {"input":{"type":"slot","value":"09:00 AM"}}.

Doctors match doctors.speciality and doctors.hospital_ids. Slots come from active doctor_assignments for the session hospital. CHATBOT_HIDE_DOCTORS_WITHOUT_SLOTS (default true) hides doctors with no free slots.

## Payment
confirm_booking returns PAYMENT_PENDING. messages[0].type is payment and messages[0].payment is the Razorpay object. amount is in paise. Open Razorpay with that object. After success, call POST /api/invoices/verify-payment, then send {"input":{"type":"payment","value":"check"}}. Paid becomes CONFIRMED. Unpaid stays PAYMENT_PENDING with the text "We haven't received your payment yet."
If the user closes checkout, Pay now reopens it: send {"input":{"type":"option","value":"pay_now"}}. The reply is PAYMENT_PENDING again with a refreshed payment object (same pending order_id, expires_in_seconds recalculated). Open Razorpay with that new object.

## Coins
ASK_COINS and ASK_COINS_AMOUNT include a coins object on the text message and on input: wallet_balance, max_usable, rate (amount_for_one_coin), consultation_fee. max_usable is min(wallet, floor(remaining / rate)). Remaining is the fee after the membership and reward discounts from the booking pricing path. The number step sets input.min to 1 and input.max to max_usable.
CONFIRM_SUMMARY breakdown uses MembershipEntitlementService::priceDoctorConsultation, the same call as doctor booking. Lines: consultation_fee, coin_discount, membership_discount, reward_discount, service_charge, taxes, total_payable. total_payable equals payment.amount / 100.
- Use coins: {"input":{"type":"option","value":"use_max"}} returns CONFIRM_SUMMARY with coins_applied = max_usable.
- Don't use coins: {"input":{"type":"option","value":"use_none"}} returns CONFIRM_SUMMARY with coins_applied 0.
- Use fewer: {"input":{"type":"option","value":"use_fewer"}} returns ASK_COINS_AMOUNT.
- Typed amount: {"input":{"type":"number","value":20}} returns CONFIRM_SUMMARY. coin_discount = coins * rate. A non-integer, zero, negative, or amount above max_usable stays on ASK_COINS_AMOUNT with 422. Above the cap the text is "You can use up to <max> coins." Nothing is clamped.

## Errors
422 keeps the same state and returns the step again with the message. An id that is not in options[] returns "Unknown option". On ASK_SYMPTOMS the message is "Unknown option: <id>" and nothing is saved. A type that does not match input.type returns "Expected input type <type>."

## input.type

| input.type | When | Request |
|---|---|---|
| option | Single choice, and every kind action | {"type":"option","value":"choose_doctor"} |
| multi_option | ASK_SYMPTOMS | {"type":"multi_option","value":["wheezing","cough"]} |
| doctor | CHOOSE_DOCTOR | {"type":"doctor","value":"<uuid>"} |
| date | CHOOSE_DATE | {"type":"date","value":"2026-10-17"} |
| slot | CHOOSE_SLOT | {"type":"slot","value":"09:00 AM"} |
| number | ASK_COINS_AMOUNT | {"type":"number","value":20} |
| payment | After verify-payment only. Not the Pay now tap. | {"type":"payment","value":"check"} |
| none | Terminal screen | — |

Aliases still accepted: symptoms → multi_option, payment_check → payment. The app should send the types in the table.
